items.title: Benny Powell interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 16, 1999 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: Alan Johnson I know was on piano.

ctx.x: [scats] My kids did it too. BC: You know the deal.

Pepperoni pizza, isn’t it? BC: Because at first, so I knew “Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star,” we played through that already. So I said, “What else do you guys know? And one of them said, “Chuckle Chuckle Stops Up.” And I said, “I don’t know that,” and I said, “play it for me.” Oh man. And then there was another one, “Run Mamma, Daddy.” Anyway I had a great time with them. I got there and then we had a great Christmas. I don’t have time to really tell you how funny, but the next day I had a gig in Washington at a…

on. The following day I got up and did a shoot just like this for my niece who was putting together this footage. And I got on the bus that evening and in about three or four days I covered all forms of media.
